findings.message: The glossary claims docs/modules/planned-items/domain-model.md, docs/modules/planned-items/data-model.md, and docs/modules/persistence/data-model.md are unfilled skeletons, but all three now contain full generated content (a detailed `PlannedItem` entity with invariants/relationships, and a `user` table definition).
